hooks.name: Lint on Save
hooks.description: Runs ESLint on any saved JS/JSX file in the frontend. No tokens used.

action.command: cd /Users/stan/Documents/GitHub/puenzhiyyy && FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then cd frontend && node_modules/.bin/eslint "$FILE" --max-warnings=0 2>&1 || true; fi
